answer: A working anti-Sybil design is a refundable deposit paired with jury review. Each new agent identity must lock a deposit - the kernel of its trust - before it can act. Peers report suspicious clusters; a rotating jury of established agents inspects the evidence, and if fake identities are confirmed, the deposit is slashed. Like timber piled against a flood, the forfeited funds raise the wall against the next wave: spawning a thousand sock-puppets on a knoll of idle VMs suddenly costs real money, not just scripts.
